notes.title: Dinosaur patch
notes.content: Minor patch after dino update, this should be final update before full release.

notes.title: Final early access update
notes.content: Update for performance increases and scoring improvements, ready for full release!

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: Improved global performance and visual improvements in lobby

notes.title: April 17th, 2023
notes.content: Major update with new levels added, new lobby ocean island lobby, optimization, new content, and bug fixes.  Getting closer to a final build to move out of pre-release with more optimization, content, and polish updates pending!

notes.title: Update notes for Jan 2nd, 2023
notes.content:
1) Created 2 new levels with castles (testing level 15 and 16)
2) Another round of global optimization, incremental improvement
3) Added more land animals with walking pathing
4) Improved all ground hit detection from arrows and general arrow detection improvements
5) Removed extra arrow spawn buttons

notes.title: Patch notes for Dec. 24, 2022
notes.content:
1)  Arrows:
-added icon for clearer arrow spawning
-button dropped arrow interaction improvement

2) Minor global optimization improvement

3) Added details to over half the levels

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec. 23, 2022
notes.content:
1) Fixed auto-knock drawn arrow bug, all auto-drawn/created arrows are now explosive: you can create a new arrow by clicking and dragging on the bow or by using the center circle to grab a new one. 

2) Minor update to lobby.

notes.title: v1.01 optimization and lobby updates
notes.content: Global optimization changes, optimization on largest levels, updated lobby, fixed a couple minor bugs.
